# USATII Media

> USATII is a Rochester, New York software development company. We design and build custom business software, owned operational systems, business websites, and responsible artificial intelligence integrations.

Legal entity: VAU Solutions, LLC
Founder and author: Vladislav Usatii
Canonical website: https://usatii.com
Primary region: Rochester and Western New York
